name: Leh

description.title: Leh – Heart of Ladakh
description.short: The heart of Ladakh, surrounded by rugged mountains, monasteries, and high passes.
description.long: Leh, the heart of Ladakh, is surrounded by rugged mountains, monasteries, and high passes. Its palaces, markets, and Buddhist culture create a unique charm. With nearby trekking trails, crystal lakes, and adventure activities, Leh offers travelers a rare mix of history, spirituality, and Himalayan beauty.
description.history: Leh was the capital of the ancient kingdom of Ladakh and is home to the Leh Palace, built in the 17th century. The city has been an important trading center on the Silk Route.
description.overview: A historic city with palaces, monasteries, and access to high-altitude adventures.

name: Alchi

description.title: Alchi – Ancient Art Village
description.short: A quiet village on the Indus River, famous for its ancient monastery with beautiful murals.
description.long: Alchi, a quiet village on the Indus River, is famous for its ancient monastery with beautiful murals and carvings. Unlike other Ladakhi monasteries, it lies on flat ground, making it unique. With its peaceful setting and artistic treasures, Alchi offers travelers a deep cultural and spiritual experience.
